organization.heading: Organization
organization.name: Name
organization.codeHint: Staff without email sign in with this code and their username.

security.heading: Sign-in security
security.requireTwoFactorHint: Everyone then signs in with a code from an authenticator app as well as their password. Staff who haven't set it up are asked to at their next sign-in.
security.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can stop requiring two-factor sign-in.
security.turnedOn: Two-factor sign-in is now required for everyone

sections.heading: More settings
sections.setupHint: What to do before your first quotation, and what's done
sections.profileHint: Your business's name, address, GST and bank details
sections.brandingHint: Your logo, colour and terms, on the quotations and invoices you issue
sections.filesHint: Documents your business keeps, such as its licences
sections.documentsHint: The documents you've issued, their PDFs and share links
sections.destinationsHint: Your agency's destinations: rename one, or merge two into one
sections.blockedContactsHint: Phone numbers, emails and Instagram handles blocked from leads
sections.leadSourcesHint: Google Sheets whose new rows become leads by themselves
sections.assignmentHint: Who new leads from sheets and imports go to: rules, turns, or the Owner
sections.auditHint: Who changed what in your organization, and when
sections.whatsappHint: Your WhatsApp number and its state
sections.quotesHint: Your UPI id, the usual GST rate and the terms under every quote
sections.salesAutomationHint: Reply to new leads in a minute, follow-ups, payment reminders, hot leads
sections.aiHint: Sells on WhatsApp by itself: answers, follows up, scores leads and learns from your chats
sections.teamNotificationsHint: Who gets emails, and copies of bookings, payments and hot leads

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.intro: Your agency's own list, which grows as leads name new places. Rename one, or merge two into one: their leads move to the one you keep.
destinations.empty: No destinations yet. Each new lead's destination is added here.
destinations.firstOnly: These are the first 100. Search to find the others.

rename.title: Rename {name}
rename.description: Its leads show the new name.
rename.name: Name

merge.title: Merge {name} into another
merge.description: {name}'s leads move to the destination you keep, and {name} leaves the list. Typing {name} later finds the one you keep. This can't be undone.
merge.done: {count, plural, =0 {Merged. No leads moved to {name}.} one {Merged. 1 lead moved to {name}.} other {Merged. # leads moved to {name}.}}

blockedContacts.title: Blocked contacts
blockedContacts.intro: Phone numbers, emails and Instagram handles blocked from a lead. The lead form warns when one comes back.
blockedContacts.empty: Nothing is blocked. A contact blocked from a lead shows here.

unblock.title: Unblock {value}?
unblock.description: The lead form stops warning about it. You can block it again from a lead.

assignment.title: Lead assignment
assignment.intro: Who gets the leads that arrive by themselves, from a form, a sheet or an import with no owner. Leads added by hand stay with whoever adds them, and a returning customer goes back to their earlier owner.

mode.label: How new leads are given out
mode.hint: Used when no rule below matches.
mode.ownerHint: Every new lead goes to the agency's Owner, who passes it on.
mode.turnsHint: The people in the pool get new leads one after another.
mode.turnsMeaning: The person whose last new lead was longest ago gets the next one. Anyone marked away is skipped.
mode.fewest_open: To whoever has the fewest open leads
mode.fewest_openHint: The person in the pool with the fewest open leads gets the next one.
mode.fewest_openMeaning: Open means New, Contacted, Quote sent or Booking requested. Ties go to whoever had a lead longest ago. Anyone marked away is skipped.

pool.label: Who takes new leads
pool.hint: The people the turns go round.
pool.empty: Nobody is in the pool, so new leads will wait in Unassigned until someone assigns them.
pool.none: No one who works leads yet.
pool.ownersFailed: The people who work leads didn't load.

rules.label: Rules
rules.hint: Tried first, from the top, in every mode. A lead that matches every condition of a rule goes to its person.
rules.personLeftHint: This rule's person no longer works leads, so it is passed over. Choose someone else or remove it.
rules.needsCondition: Give each rule a source, destination or trip type, and a person.

hours.label: Working hours and reply time
hours.hint: Leads are given out at any hour. The hours only decide when the reply clock runs.
hours.zone: Times are in {zone}, your business profile's time zone.
hours.noDays: With no days chosen, the reply clock counts every hour.

slowReply.label: Tell managers when a new lead has no reply
slowReply.hint: Everyone who can assign leads is told when a new lead is still New after this much working time. Nothing is reassigned.

problems.closing: Closing time must be after opening time.
